headline: CCE and Concamin Reject Double-Digit Increase in Minimum Wage
summary: CCE and Concamin, Mexican business organizations, said companies cannot absorb a larger financial burden from a double-digit rise in the minimum wage. The statement was made on behalf of industry.
why: Minimum wage changes in Mexico raise labor costs for employers across retail, manufacturing and services, which affects margins and inflation expectations.
original_headline: CCE y Concamin rechazan incremento a doble digito del salario mínimo
